newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Philips Medical wins Paris hospital deal.
newsitem.headline: Philips Medical wins Paris hospital deal.

text.p: Philips Medical Systems, part of Philips Electronics NV, said on Tuesday it had won a deal to provide radiology information systems to connect 50 hospitals in Paris, the largest hospital group in Europe.

The firm said in a statement it will install two pilot schemes, deploy 40 radiology information systems and provide staff training in their use. The project will roll out over the next four to five years starting this September.
A Philips spokeswoman declined to give a total value for the contract but said a typical base price for a system was around $250,000, excluding hardware and maintenance costs.
"It's hard to give a straight figure because each customer orders something based on their own configuration," she said, adding the bidding was won after a long competitive process.
The radiology information systems are used by hospital radiology departments in registration and tracking of patients, results, reports, billing and database management.
